fields.name: name
fields.description: Model family, e.g. s7comm-stage1-detector; with version, the bundle's identity in every prediction

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version within the family, e.g. v2

fields.name: schemaId
fields.description: Feature schema the detector was trained on, s7comm-feature-v1; must resolve in FeatureSchemaRegistry, whose feature order must equal preprocessing.json's raw_feature_order

fields.name: sequenceLength
fields.description: Events per window, for example 16; must equal policy.json's score_semantics.sequence_length

fields.name: featureCount
fields.description: Preprocessed values per event, for example 22 (detector v2); must equal preprocessing.json's transformed_dimension

fields.name: inputName
fields.description: The ONNX graph's input, shape [?, sequenceLength, featureCount]

fields.name: outputName
fields.description: The reconstruction output, shape [?, sequenceLength or symbolic, featureCount]

fields.name: zeroWeightFeatures
fields.description: Raw features whose preprocessed columns weigh 0 in the score: the release's identity_features_excluded_from_event_score

fields.name: preprocessingSha
fields.description: SHA-256 of preprocessing.json, the release's preprocessor_contract.json byte for byte

fields.name: policySha
fields.description: SHA-256 of policy.json, the release's causal_online_shadow_policy.json byte for byte

fields.name: calibrationSha
fields.description: SHA-256 of calibration.npz, the release's causal_online_conformal_calibration_scores.npz byte for byte
